description: Update an existing hook on a quiz. Requires quizId and numeric hookId; `updates` is a partial HookInput.

hookId.description: Numeric id of the hook to update (from list_quiz_hooks).

quizId.description: Quiz ID in YouTube-style 11-character base64url format.

updates.description: Partial HookInput object; only included fields are updated.

name: quiz_video_update_quiz_hook
title: Update a quiz hook
